summary: OpenAI published two enterprise research reports (Enterprise Signals and a working paper) describing how enterprise customers' use of ChatGPT and Codex has shifted from assistant-style queries toward agentic, delegated work, with usage metrics on output tokens, Plugins/skills adoption, and Codex growth across functions.

mechanisms.reason: The report states that agentic Codex usage now generates the majority of enterprise output tokens and that agent adoption is growing rapidly across knowledge-work functions beyond engineering.
mechanisms.quote: As of June, Codex generated 64% of combined Codex and ChatGPT output tokens among enterprise customers, suggesting that agents are enabling a shift toward more substantive, delegated work.

mechanisms.reason: The report quantifies a widening gap in output tokens generated per active user over time, indicating rising inference volume among heavy-usage enterprise customers.
mechanisms.quote: Frontier firms—those in the top 10% of AI usage each month—now generate 8.3× as many output tokens per active user as typical firms, up from 2.6× in January.
